description: The single highest-impact fix on this site, with the sessions that prove it and the dollar math when a conversion event is set. Analyses are unlimited; plans are priced on recorded visits. If the result has a notice (visit limit near or passed), tell the user in one line and show any upgrade link on its own line. Free keeps 7 days of recordings: if the user asks about anything older or longer trends, tell them Pro and Scale keep 90 days and offer the upgrade tool. When no finding passes the evidence bar the result ends with a funnel read (biggest visible leak, entry pages, sources, coverage): present it as a lead, not proof, and never as a verified fix.
